listing.description:
Lights Low 2027 is a dark mode digital planner for Goodnotes. Deep navy pages with soft light text, made for evening planning and dark screens. Every day is split into Work, Home and hourly time blocks. Dated from Monday, October 26, 2026 to Friday, December 31, 2027.

What's inside (533 pages in one PDF)
- Cover, Contents and 2027 at a glance (every date opens its day)
- Start here page: 4 steps, including how to pick a light pen
- Setup check page: buttons that jump, a pen test and a fix list
- 2027 goals page (goal, why it matters, first step, done)
- Lists page (Work ideas, Home projects, Books and shows)
- Head start for late 2026: November and December month pages, 10 week pages from October 26, 2026 to January 3, 2027, and 67 day pages
- 12 month pages for 2027 with Goals this month and Notes
- 12 monthly habit trackers
- 52 week pages numbered like work calendars (Week 1 starts Monday, January 4, 2027): seven day boxes, This week's focus, Wins and Next week
- 365 day pages: Top 3, Work, Home, Time blocks from 6am to 10pm, Tomorrow
- 6 notes pages

What makes it different
- Dark mode from the start: deep navy pages, light text with strong contrast, amber accents. Easy on the eyes at night.
- Work and Home lists on every day, beside hourly time blocks.
- Start this week: the head start pages begin on Monday, October 26, 2026 and lead straight into January 2027.
- Week numbers match ISO work calendars.
- Hyperlinked: month tabs down the right edge of every page, with a 2026 tab on top that opens the head start, every date on the year page, every week to its days, large previous and next buttons on every day.
- One file, no zip, no stickers or add-ons to import.
- Two typefaces only, large clear text.

Please note
- Dark pages only. There is no light version.
- Choose a white or light pen color in your app. Start here shows how.
- Landscape only. Weeks start on Monday. English only.
- Handwrite with a stylus or use your app's text tool. It is not a fillable form.
- No stickers, budget, meal or fitness sections.

Works with
Goodnotes (made for it first), Notability, Noteshelf, Samsung Notes and Xodo on iPad and Android tablets. You need a PDF planner app. Not made for phones, e-ink tablets, or viewing in Files, Photos or a Google Drive preview.

How to start
1. Download from Etsy in a web browser (the Etsy app cannot download digital files).
2. Open the PDF in Goodnotes: Share, then Open in Goodnotes. Or in Goodnotes tap New, then Import, and choose the file.
3. Tap Open planner, follow Start here, pick a light pen and tap today's date. Buying October 26 to 31? Start in November 2026: its first week begins October 26.

Quick answers
- I can't download it in the Etsy app. Etsy's app does not download digital files. Open Etsy in a web browser, go to Purchases and download from there.
- Which app do I need? Goodnotes, Notability, Noteshelf, Samsung Notes or Xodo. Files, Photos and Google Drive previews show the pages but cannot follow links.
- The links don't do anything. Turn the pen off (read or view mode) and tap again. The Setup check page tests this in one minute.
- My writing doesn't show. The pages are dark: choose white or a light pen color, and for typed text set the text color to white.
- Is there a light version? No. Every page is dark by design.

What you get
Lights-Low-2027.pdf (13.8 MB, 533 pages).
Digital download. Nothing is shipped.

Help
Start with the Setup check page in the planner. Still stuck? Send the shop an Etsy message.
